## Page 13

Overall  Trends :
The data  reveals  a significant  shift  in market  dynamics  between  2019  and  
2025 . While  China  remains  the dominant  revenue  engine,  it has entered  a 
period  of volatility  and correction . South  Korea  exhibits  a stabilizing  trend  
after  a post -pandemic  peak,  whereas  Southeast  Asia  (SEA)  represents  
the most  consistent  growth  opportunity,  nearing  a potential  "breakout"  
phase .
Key  Takeaway :
The 'Easy  Growth'  era of 2020 -2022  is over ; the market  is now  in a 
maturity  phase  where  we must  source  games  with  proven  monetization,  
not just high  download  potential .

The era of easy  organic  growth  through  massive  download  volumes  has 
ended  in all three  regions . With  downloads  dropping  by double  digits  in 
major  markets  like China  (-17.3%) and SEA (-12.3%), management  can no 
longer  rely on a steady  stream  of new  "free"  users  to fuel growth .
Key  Takeaway :
Since  the "top of the funnel"  (new  downloads)  is shrinking,  the business  
model  must  pivot . The focus  should  shift  from  User  Acquisition  (UA)  to 
User  Lifetime  Value  (LTV) . Success  will be defined  by how  well a 
company  can retain  its existing,  mature  audience  rather  than  how  many  
new  installs  it can generate .ONLINE GAMES: THE GLOBAL MARKET BY PLATFORM
